categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in passive components and electronic components, including research, development, production, and sales of multilayer ceramic capacitors (MLCC), tantalum capacitors, chip resistors, magnetic components, sensors, and related production equipment and raw materials. It also extends its product portfolio to circuit protection components, wireless components, and sensors. The company focuses on high-end markets such as automotive, industrial control, aerospace, medical, AI, 5G, and IoT applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses advanced technologies in materials, processes, and equipment design, including in-house production of high-grade ceramic powders and metal pastes for MLCCs. It emphasizes high capacitance, high voltage tolerance, high reliability, miniaturization, and specialized product lines for various applications. Manufacturing processes include multilayer ceramic capacitor fabrication, chip resistor printing and firing, tantalum capacitor assembly, and sensor sub-assembly with precision testing. The company also integrates proprietary technologies for high-frequency, high-power, and automotive-grade components.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global leaders in automotive electronics, industrial automation, aerospace, medical devices, consumer electronics, wireless communications, cloud networking, and 5G infrastructure. The company serves end markets such as automotive, industrial, aerospace, medical, AI, 5G/IoT, consumer electronics, and telecommunications. It maintains strong partnerships with major global brands and distributors in these sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with significant market presence in Greater China, Americas, Europe, Japan, and Asia-Pacific regions. It has subsidiaries and manufacturing facilities in Taiwan, China, Vietnam, Malaysia, Japan, Europe, and the United States. Sales distribution shows approximately 50% in Greater China, 14% in Americas, 23% in Europe, and 13% in other Asia-Pacific regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the electronics supply chain, manufacturing passive electronic components and related products. It controls upstream raw material processing for key inputs like ceramic powders and metal pastes and provides downstream components to OEMs and system integrators in various industries. It also engages in strategic acquisitions to expand its product portfolio and market reach.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding high-end markets in Europe, America, and Japan, increasing the proportion of niche and high-value products, and integrating recent acquisitions such as Heraeus Nexensos and Telemecanique Sensors. The company invests heavily in R&D, focusing on miniaturization, high capacitance, high voltage, high reliability, automotive-grade components, and advanced sensor technologies. It plans to increase R&D spending to over NT$3.6 billion and emphasizes innovation in AI, EV, 5G, industrial, medical, and aerospace applications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of passive electronic components and sensors. The company also derives income from licensing its technologies and providing integrated component solutions. It issues convertible bonds and employee stock options as part of its capital structure but mainly relies on direct sales to global customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a global leader and the only supplier with leading positions simultaneously in resistors, capacitors, and inductors. It competes with major industry players such as Murata, TDK, KOA, Rohm, AVX, Vishay, Panasonic, and others. Its competitive advantages include comprehensive product offerings, advanced technology, global supply chain, and strong presence in high-end niche markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$121.67 billion with a gross margin of 34.4% and net profit attributable to owners of NT$19.36 billion. It has shown steady growth with a 13.1% increase in revenue and 11.1% increase in net profit year-over-year. Total assets reached NT$366.68 billion with equity of NT$162.55 billion. The company maintains a strong financial structure with a debt-to-asset ratio of 55.67% and a current ratio of 138.88%. It continues to invest in capacity expansion and strategic acquisitions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers a unique one-stop solution platform with leading technology and design capabilities across the three major passive component categories. It emphasizes high-quality, high-reliability, and high-performance products tailored for advanced applications such as automotive, industrial, aerospace, medical, AI, and 5G/IoT. Its vertically integrated manufacturing, proprietary materials, and process control ensure cost efficiency and product excellence. The company’s global footprint and comprehensive product portfolio enable it to meet diverse customer needs and provide superior supply chain stability.
